title: SkillMap DeviceAuth v1 Common Definitions
description: Shared bounded primitives for the DeviceAuth v1 wire contract (M1.08 + P-256 amendment v2). All identifiers use exact ASCII grammars; bytes are measured after UTF-8 encoding.

DeviceId.description: 128-bit random identifier encoded base64url without padding; immutable for a device lineage.

IdempotencyKey.description: 128-bit random idempotency key (required header, never a body field).

DevicePublicKey.description: Base64url (no padding) canonical 91-byte DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo for an uncompressed P-256 point (proof suite skillmap.ecdsa-p256-sha256.v2).

KeyThumbprint.description: sha256:<hex> over the exact 91 DER SPKI bytes.

Scope.description: v1 exact scope allowlist. Canonicalized by bytewise sort/deduplicate; M3.03 stores and re-echoes the canonical set.

Locale.description: BCP-47 canonical presentation tag (ASCII letters/digits/hyphens). Presentation-only.

DisplayName.description: Trimmed, NFC-normalized, single-line UTF-8, 1-64 bytes; controls and line separators rejected. Must already be normalized before wire.

UnixSeconds.description: Unsigned decimal Unix seconds, no leading zeroes.
